verdict.rationale: Attio explicitly documents natural-language operation: 'Manage Attio via AI. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your AI tool of choice to search, update and manage your Attio workspace' and 'Ask Attio to build workflows for you just by describing the goal,' backed by an official MCP server endpoint, plus 'Search, update, and create with AI' features. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of natural-language command accuracy and breadth beyond vendor marketing pages.
